incidents.name: GROKD depositFromIDO missing access control
incidents.notes: The GROKD deposit contract's depositFromIDO() has no access control, letting the attacker credit itself an arbitrary IDO stake and withdraw the corresponding pending rewards.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x31d3231cDa62C0b7989b488cA747245676a32D81 created 2024-04-03T13:19:48Z by 0xa2bc1f61b3527563a9796134a0f0d56b1085f5d4, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x2f5181aaab8776d8c67d4505ff47213391908b34; 6 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from last of 6 upgrade events (onchain). ~150 BNB x $581.07/BNB at the incident timestamp 1712406026 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $87,161.
